subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should the setup owner accept the proposed persistence boundary—Back before writes, retained accepted install metadata, and discarded wizard-local state—and merge it after latest-main validation?
rationale: The code establishes product-significant ownership around configuration writes, plugin installation records, and setup hooks; tests and video support the intended behavior, but maintainers must confirm that boundary remains the desired upgrade behavior on the latest base.

options.title: Review and merge after refresh
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, rerun the focused setup/navigation tests and terminal proof on the exact head, then merge if the owner confirms the persistence boundary.

options.title: Narrow the boundary
options.body: Request a smaller follow-up that limits Back to non-persistent adapters if maintainers do not want accepted install metadata or hook behavior governed by this shared coordinator.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, rerun the focused setup/navigation tests and terminal proof on the exact head, then merge if the owner confirms the persistence boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current and related setup-contract contributor and can explain the intended boundary to the reviewing setup owner.
